name: Half-Life: Alyx Jailbreak — Standalone VR
summary: Standalone Half-Life: Alyx on Meta Quest, with Steam downloads, cloud-save import and adjustable graphics. 0.342 adds a flashlight shortcut and thousands of optimized models. Valve Auto Fidelity is strongly recommended. PICO compatibility is unverified after the GNU/glibc transition. Requires Half-Life: Alyx on Steam.
